Courses per person per day: \(2+2+3+3=10\).
Plates per person per day: \(10 \times 2 = 20\).

Daily people totals:
- Days 1–3: \(11\) people
- Day 4: \(7\) people
- Days 5–6: \(5\) people

Total person-days: \(3\cdot 11 + 1\cdot 7 + 2\cdot 5 = 33+7+10=50\).

Total plates: \(50 \times 20 = 1000\).

\boxed{1000}
